UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT, DISTRICT OF WESTBROOK

PRIYA NATARAJAN,
                Plaintiff,
        v.                              Case No. 24-CV-07712
HARTWELL ANALYTICS, INC.,
                Defendant.

COMPLAINT (TITLE VII, ADEA, FMLA RETALIATION)

Plaintiff PRIYA NATARAJAN alleges:

JURISDICTION
1. This action arises under Title VII of the Civil Rights Act of 1964, 42 U.S.C. § 2000e et seq.; the Age Discrimination in Employment Act, 29 U.S.C. § 621 et seq.; and the Family and Medical Leave Act, 29 U.S.C. § 2601 et seq. Plaintiff exhausted administrative remedies with the EEOC (Right-to-Sue dated 10/14/2024, Ex. A).

PARTIES
2. Plaintiff is a 54-year-old woman of South Asian (Indian) national origin who was employed by Defendant from March 2014 to August 8, 2024.
3. Defendant HARTWELL ANALYTICS, INC. is a Delaware corporation with approximately 480 employees nationwide.

FACTS
4. Plaintiff was hired in 2014 as a Senior Data Analyst. By 2019 she was promoted to Director of Analytics. She received "Exceeds Expectations" performance ratings every year from 2016 through 2022.
5. In January 2023, Plaintiff was reassigned under new VP of Engineering, BRENDAN COULTER (age 38, white, male).
6. Beginning in February 2023, Coulter repeatedly made comments to Plaintiff and others including: "You and I think differently — generationally"; "Maybe it's time to bring in someone more current"; and (to a colleague, in a meeting Plaintiff did not attend but for which a recording exists, Ex. D) "I want to refresh the analytics team — we're stale."
7. In May 2023, Coulter restructured the analytics team and removed Plaintiff's three direct reports without consulting Plaintiff or providing a business justification.
8. Plaintiff's 2023 performance review (delivered 02/2024) for the first time in her tenure rated her "Meets Expectations Minus." Coulter authored the review.
9. On March 14, 2024, Plaintiff was diagnosed with breast cancer requiring surgery and chemotherapy. She requested FMLA leave starting April 1, 2024 for an estimated 14 weeks. The request was approved.
10. On July 8, 2024, while still on FMLA leave, Plaintiff was contacted by HR and informed that her position was being "eliminated due to restructuring." She was offered a non-equivalent IC role (no direct reports, $42,000 pay reduction) or severance.
11. The "restructuring" affected exactly one position: Plaintiff's. No comparable Director-level role was eliminated. Within 30 days of Plaintiff's separation, Hartwell posted a "Senior Director, Analytics Strategy" role with materially similar responsibilities.
12. The role was filled in October 2024 by JESSICA HAYDEN (age 31, white, female), who reports to Coulter.

CLAIMS
Count I — Title VII (National Origin Discrimination)
Count II — ADEA (Age Discrimination)
Count III — FMLA Retaliation
Count IV — Title VII Retaliation (for Plaintiff's internal complaint of 06/12/2023, Ex. E)

JURY TRIAL DEMANDED.

Dated: November 2, 2024
                                /s/ C. Whitfield, Esq.
